name: Seo Gyu Yeon
source:
A teacher at a cooking school run by Beumi mother. He have been close to Beumi since 4 years ago when He came to this town. When he was young, he was tired of playing brilliantly and now he feel like he want to live faithfully. Doing better than cooking is a housework.
